Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE MEMBER OF THECOLOMBO MUNICIPAL COUNCILUNDER SECTION 65A(2) OF THELOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262) AS AMENDED BYLOCAL AUTHORITIES (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT No. 30 OF 2013
WHEREAS the office of a member in Colombo Municipal Council has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the recognized political party namely Democratic Peoples Front, to whichthe former member, Kurusamy Kalangandi Thevar belonged, was required by me under Section 65A(2) of the aforesaidOrdinance, to nominate within a period of thirty (30) days a person eligible under the Ordinance for election as amember of that Colombo Municipal Council who shall be declared elected as a member ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has nominated Mrs. Manjula Perumalbeing an eligible person under the aforesaid Ordinance to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE, I, Sivasubramaniam Achchuthan, Returning Officer of Colombo Municipal Council, actingin terms of Section 65A(2) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance as amended by filling of Vacancies in Localauthorities (Special Provisions) Act, No. 30 of 2013 (Chapter 262) do hereby declare Mrs. Manjula Perumal elected as amember of the Colombo Municipal Council.
S. ACHCHUTHAN,Returning Officer,Colombo Municipal Council.City Elections Office,Colombo,18th September, 2015.
